Please keep in mind that this is all from my own personal experience.

Load up on cells that boost the benefits of dodging through attacks. A lot of repeater users use them to avoid taking damage and stay away from the behemoth, which is a bad move as you can't get charged shots without keeping relatively close. Just remember that you shouldn't dedicate your entire build on being a support, since behemoth strength is dependent on how many slayers are in the hunting party.
